title: Emergency Management and Homeland Security - Cybersecurity
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Emergency Management and Homeland Security - Cybersecurity - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS1087/C/MCE1087
outcomes: Recognize the types of natural, manmade, and technological hazards that can negatively impact a community.
Compare and contrast various forms of National and International Terrorism.
Distinguish the fundamental roles and responsibilities of the professional emergency manager.
Demonstrate skills necessary to prepare for, mitigate, respond to, and recover from manmade and natural disasters.
Demonstrate an understanding of the role of cybersecurity professionals in the Homeland Security Enterprise.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the Associate of Science Degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the certificate shares the same Program Requirements (24.00 units) and the same Program Learning Outcomes list, recorded here for the certificate.

The page shows a third heading line with different control numbers (MAS1015/MAS1015B/MAS1015C/MCE1015) than the first two (MAS1087/C/MCE1087); a reviewer may want to confirm which control number applies to this certificate.
General education applies only to the A.S. degree and is not part of the certificate; ge_pattern left null.
